texts.import.about: Makes a Chimera project from a Gens movie: the pads and the Team Player it was recorded with as the project's settings, the cartridge, and its frames as the project's inputs. When the project is opened, it finds the cartridge beside it or asks for it.
texts.import.done: The project is written: %1 frames, %2 rerecords. The pads are set as the movie says, and the cartridge's SRAM starts empty, as with Gens' Clear SRAM playback option. If the movie was not made with the region set to automatic, choose its region in the project's settings.
texts.import.done_pal: The project is written: %1 frames, %2 rerecords. The pads are set as the movie says, and the cartridge's SRAM starts empty, as with Gens' Clear SRAM playback option. The movie was recorded at 50 Hz: choose the region it was made with (Europe or Japan PAL) in the project's settings, unless the cartridge selects it.
texts.import.gmv_empty: This Gens movie has no frames.
texts.import.gmv_not_gmv: This is not a Gens movie (GMV) file.
texts.import.gmv_old: This Gens movie is older than version 9 and does not say which pads it used.
texts.import.gmv_pads: This Gens movie does not say whether its pads have three or six buttons.
texts.import.gmv_savestate: This Gens movie starts from a savestate. Only movies that start at power-on can be imported.
texts.import.no_movie: The movie file could not be read.
texts.import.not_written: The project could not be written.
texts.import.unknown_tool: This core has no such tool.
texts.import.which_game: Choose the cartridge the movie was made with.
texts.setting.p1bpad.about: The pad on Team Player connector 1B, used only with the Team Player. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.p1cpad.about: The pad on Team Player connector 1C, used only with the Team Player. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.p1pad.about: The pad in port 1: six buttons or three. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.p2pad.about: The pad in port 2: six buttons or three. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.region.about: The console's region. auto reads it from the cartridge as Gens does, preferring USA, then Japan, then Europe. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.spritelimit.about: Draws only as many sprites on a line as the console can. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.teamplayer.about: A Team Player adapter in port 1, with players 1, 2 and 3 on its pads 1, 1B and 1C. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.ym2612improvement.about: Gens' interpolated FM sound. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.rom.help: The Mega Drive / Genesis cartridge, as a .bin, .md, .gen or interleaved .smd file.
